en: A black‑and‑white night view of a wide city street flanked by tall buildings. Dominating the scene are two symmetrical high-rise towers connected by a bridge in the distance, with light trails from cars on the street below. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Kungsgatan with the Kungstornen (Kings' Towers) in evening illumination in Stockholm. Printer/publisher details appear in the lower right corner.
